title: Founder reference
description: One work that forms the founder: a book, podcast, film, video, essay or talk (founders/<handle>/references/<id>.json). Stored once at founder scope and cited by id from ideas, ventures and decisions. The bibliographic fields follow CSL-JSON names (type, title, author, issued, container-title, URL) so a citation tool reads them as they are; why and met are the founder's.

type.description: CSL type. A podcast episode is broadcast; a film is motion_picture; a talk is speech

literal.description: An organization, or a name that does not split

container-title.description: The show, publication or site it appeared in

met.description: When the founder first read, heard or watched it

why.description: What it did for the founder, in their own words

quotes.description: Exact quotes only. A paraphrase goes in why, never here

ethos.description: The ideas of the founder's ethos it supports, in short phrases

added_by.description: An agent may add a reference it found; only the founder's own list says it formed them
